2607.12469.title: Agent-Safety Evaluations as Load-Bearing Evidence: A Vendor-Neutral, Cross-Harness Reconstructability Metric
2607.12469.paper_summary: Many agent-safety evaluation results are not yet load-bearing evidence: identical nominal outcomes (task success, attack success, monitor scores) may sit atop materially different evidence regimes. No vendor-neutral, runnable instrument scores reconstructability as an evaluation-validity metric: whether captured evidence can reconstruct the decision a claim depends on. This paper introduces a property-level reconstructability metric over eight decision-property classes and a cross-harness adapter emitting per-decision Evidence Sufficiency Cards backing a per-run monitor-coverage release check. It specifies a counterfactual-replay intervention protocol, implements its replayability-precondition probe, and defines a claim-evidence overclaim gap. On public and bundled traces, without new model runs, twelve-field sufficiency spans 0.458-0.833 across four inputs sharing a surface reading; replay preconditions are unmet in every scored trace. In a synthetic release-gate pair, the sufficiency gate blocks the raw variant (0.542) and passes the instrumented (0.667). Safety-evaluation claims should travel with their reconstructability vector; a reproducibility package regenerates every reported number.
2607.12469.paper_summary_zh: 許多代理安全評估結果尚未成為可承載的證據：相同的名義結果（任務成功、攻擊成功、監控分數）可能基於實質上不同的證據體系。沒有供應商中立的可執行工具分數能夠重建作為評估有效性指標的可重建性：捕獲的證據是否能重建一個聲明所依賴的決策。本文介紹了一種針對八個決策屬性類別的屬性級別可重建性指標，以及一個跨平台適配器，發出每個決策的證據充分性卡，以支持每次運行的監控覆蓋釋放檢查。它指定了一個反事實重放干預協議，實施其重放性前提探測，並定義了一個聲明-證據過度聲明的差距。在公共和捆綁的追蹤中，無需新的模型運行，十二個領域的充分性範圍為0.458-0.833，四個輸入共享一個表面閱讀；在每個得分的追蹤中，重放前提均未滿足。在一對合成的釋放閘中，充分性閘阻擋了原始變體（0.542），並通過了儀器化的（0.667）。安全評估聲明應隨其可重建性向量一起傳遞；一個可重複性包會再生每一個報告的數字。
2607.12469.author: Oleg Solozobov et.al.
